implementation: KC API using CPACF for AES, TDES and GHASH
description: Ubuntu Kernel Crypto API cryptographic module provides cryptographic services to the software components executing as part of the Linux kernel. This test covers the implementations of gcm_base(ctr-aes-s390,ghash-s390), ccm_base(ctr-aes-s390,aes-s390), cbc-aes-s390, ecb-aes-s390, xts-aes-s390, cbc-des3_ede-s390, ecb-des3_ede-s390, ctr-des3_ede-s390.
